headline: Going Commando reaches 84.74% matched code as launcher and mod improvements land
summary: Going Commando USA v1.01 reaches 7,760 of 8,579 matching functions and 84.74% of code; rac2-decomp#386 also reports USA v2.00 at 80.93% and Europe/Australia at 54.14% of code. Ratchet & Clank keeps its complete code match while contributor cleanup and C data work land, and Deadlocked gains PAL matching and disc-extraction improvements. Launcher Development builds gain indexed mod installs, graphics and control fixes, while stable receives a direct PAL level 11 lighting-bake fix rather than its usual release pull request (OpenRAC#189). Archipelago v2.1.0 remembers save-slot rooms, Item Randomizer v1.0.4 ships, and Difficulty v1.2.4 fixes Blarg Station spawns; players can help test randomizer logic in openrac-mods#25. The Going Commando native port remains an unplayable draft, and expanded co-op remains unmerged.
